description: DataFast is a web analytics platform that helps teams track website traffic, goals, funnels, visitors, and revenue attribution. It also supports payment-provider integrations so users can connect business metrics like subscriptions, MRR, LTV, and churn to acquisition sources.
summary: DataFast exposes a REST API at `https://datafa.st/api/v1/`, a Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://datafa.st/api/mcp`, and an npm-installed `datafast` CLI; auth is via `df_` website keys, `dft_` account tokens, and MCP OAuth for the MCP surface.
